data.name: Jabe
data.gender_notes: Jabe is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jabe is recorded in name-lists as “God is my father”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jabe expresses “God is my father”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabe total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: יָבֶה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jabe is derived from the root 'yabh' which means 'to be beautiful, to be father'. Thus, Jabe can be translated as 'father of beauty'.

in_greek.name: Ιαβε
in_greek.long_meaning: In the Greek Septuagint, Jabe is transliterated as Ιαβε (Iabē), which is essentially a transliteration of the Hebrew name.

in_latin.name: Iabes
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, Jabe is transliterated as Iabes, which is derived from the Greek Ιαβε (Iabē).

biblical_reference.note: Jabe is the name of the father of Mephibosheth, who was a descendant of Saul and was shown mercy by David.
